channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Fitbit Edge launches today: Google's $180 tracker with a Gemini coach and a week of battery
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google's new band-style fitness tracker is on pre-order today at $180: a 1.34-inch always-on display, built-in GPS, ECG and AFib detection, a user-replaceable battery, and a Gemini-powered Health Coach that builds your weekly training plan.

item.title: Build your own spy-satellite console: track every plane, ship, and satellite live — hands-on with God's Eye View
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: God's Eye View (bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view, 52,000+ GitHub stars) packs a spy-satellite console into your browser — 11,000+ live aircraft, thousands of ships, an 838-object satellite catalog, earthquakes, weather, and a voice-controlled AI agent — most of it with zero API keys. This tutorial installs it, tracks a live flight, and talks to the globe.

item.title: Budget Direct took ChatGPT's insurance ad slot almost alone: 7,029 ads while Allianz, NRMA and AAMI ran zero
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Somantra ran 34,279 unbranded insurance queries through ChatGPT from Australia and found one company buying the ad slot almost alone: Budget Direct's 7,029 ads were 60.7% of every ad that sold insurance, while the insurers ChatGPT names most often ran none.

item.title: TikTok's CEO sees AI cracking physics and biotech within three years: "very, very, very possible"
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew told a Singapore conference on Monday that AI will deliver "real scientific breakthroughs" in physics, biotech, chemistry and material science within two to three years — and warned that alignment is the question that comes with it.

item.title: 2CRSi's Aether gambit: a former GM factory in Strasbourg becomes Europe's largest AI-infrastructure site
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: French server maker 2CRSi announced October 12 that Aether Infrastructures has signed a preliminary agreement to buy the 90-hectare Dumarey Powerglide site in Strasbourg's Port du Rhin — the first step toward what the company bills as Europe's largest industrial site dedicated to AI infrastructure.

item.title: Infinigence AI raises RMB 2.3B Series C: the mixed-chip compute bet keeps paying
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Chinese AI infrastructure startup Infinigence AI closed a RMB 2.3 billion (~$320M) Series C on October 12, bringing total financing to RMB 4.3 billion. Its pitch: 37,000 petaflops stitched across 16 chip types for training and inference.

item.title: KT locks in December launch for ‘AI for Everyone’: 17 Korean companies hold summit in Seoul
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: KT and 16 partner companies held the ‘AI for Everyone Connect Summit 2026’ in Seoul on October 12, confirming a December official launch for the integrated AI service pairing Korean-made models with everyday services — with a beta due later this month.

item.title: Turn any document into an editable PowerPoint deck: hands-on with PPT Master
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PPT Master (hugohe3/ppt-master, MIT) is an agent skill that turns PDFs, DOCX files, and pasted text into real, natively editable PowerPoint decks — native shapes, data-backed charts, real slide masters — instead of flattened images. This tutorial installs it, points it at a document, and generates a first deck.

item.title: Sui Foundation bets $30M on AI's data supply problem: DATA Network retires its own chain for Sui
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Sui Foundation and the DATA Foundation announced on October 12 that DATA Network — formerly Story Protocol — will retire its own blockchain and run as a protocol on Sui. The Sui Foundation is backing the move with a $30 million investment, its largest institutional stake, while the Trace registry of rights-cleared AI training data comes onto the Sui stack.

item.title: Singapore pulls ahead on AI maturity: 17% of firms are 'Frontier' and 41% say AI is growing revenue, IDC finds
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: New IDC research commissioned by Microsoft finds 17% of Singapore organisations have reached 'Frontier Firm' status — nearly double the 10% global average — with 41% saying AI is already growing revenue or creating new revenue streams.

item.title: SWI Group raises €800M at a €6.1B valuation to build AI compute on both sides of the Atlantic
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Euronext-listed SWI Group announced an €800 million capital increase at a €6.1 billion final valuation, pushing total equity raised since March past €1 billion — all aimed at data centers and AI compute across Europe and the US.

item.title: Amazon’s ~$7B Decart talks: the real-time AI video startup that Nvidia and Anthropic both walked away from
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Amazon is in talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart for around $7 billion — months after Nvidia and Anthropic both pursued and abandoned their own deals for the real-time video and world-model company.

item.title: Washington drops the UK testing ban: OpenAI and Anthropic can share frontier models with Britain's AI Safety Institute
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Trump administration has reversed its earlier request that US labs keep new models from Britain's AI Security Institute until after release, the Telegraph reported Sunday — opening the door to early-access safety testing by London.

item.title: Boot an operating system that is an AI agent: hands-on with Herald OS
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Herald OS (iamlukethedev/Herald-OS, MIT) is an agent-native operating system with Hermes Agent as the interface — 429 GitHub stars in its first five days. Talk or type to Hermes and it opens apps, organises files, runs routines on a schedule, and builds software while you watch. This tutorial: boot it in a virtual machine, give it a model, and put it through its paces.

item.title: FF Nova: Faraday Future sets October 14 for its first humanoid robot — invite-only reveal, plus a Mini and a developer RL platform
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Faraday Future and FF EAI Robotics will host a joint October 14 launch event headlined by FF Nova, the company's first embodied-AI humanoid robot. Alongside it: a smaller FF Nova Mini for classrooms, an education ecosystem brain, and a developer reinforcement-learning platform.

item.title: Google's $15B Visakhapatnam AI hub: air cooling, 120% water payback — and a jobs math locals aren't buying
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Construction of Google's $15 billion 'gigawatt-scale' AI hub in Visakhapatnam has met local resistance over water, power and jobs. In an October 11 AFP interview, Google's APAC infrastructure chief Alexander Smith answered point by point — while activists demanded a statewide data-center moratorium.

item.title: Deploy your own private AI assistant to Cloudflare with one command: hands-on with Talorys
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Talorys (rociiu/talorys, MIT) deploys a private AI assistant into your own Cloudflare account with one command — chat, memory, tasks, and scheduled reminders on the free tier. Roughly 720 GitHub stars in its first two days. This tutorial: deploy it, teach it to remember things, and set up automations.

item.title: Nearly $48B into robotics in 2026 — and the money is going to filming humans wash dishes
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Robotics and physical-AI startups have raised nearly $48B this year, per PitchBook data cited by the FT — and a growing share of it is going not to chips or models but to filming humans do ordinary work. The industry's scarcest resource isn't compute anymore; it's footage of hands folding laundry.

item.title: Airbrush Studio is here: the AI that unblinks your group photos comes to Windows and Mac
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Pixocial launched Airbrush Studio on October 11 — a free desktop app for Windows and Mac that brings its AI portrait toolkit to the big screen: a closed-eye fix that rebuilds blinked eyes, one-click expression changes, and skin retouching that keeps your freckles.

item.title: Geely's Zhanjian 700 goes on sale: an electrified off-road SUV with an AI all-terrain brain
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Geely launched the Zhanjian 700 in China on October 11 — its first electrified off-road SUV and the first vehicle on its dedicated GTA architecture. An AI all-terrain driving system reads the ground and picks the vehicle's settings; pre-sales are open with deliveries expected before year-end.

item.title: Odyssey-3 goes public: a free world model you can steer in real time
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Odyssey opened a public research preview of Odyssey-3, its 14-billion-parameter generative world model. A free demo builds interactive environments from a text prompt and lets you walk through them in real time — and the same model already steers robot arms, drones, and a car on real roads in India.

item.title: Strip the AI accent from your Japanese drafts: a hands-on tour of yomiyasu
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: yomiyasu (nanaism/yomiyasu, MIT) is an open-source agent skill that turns AI-generated Japanese into text people can actually read: roughly 1,850 GitHub stars as of October 2026. Today we'll install it in Claude Code, run it on a sloppy AI-written draft, check the result with its built-in linters, and learn what it can't fix.

item.title: Teach your coding agent to teach itself: a hands-on tour of Reef's self-improving harness
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Reef (Human-Agent-Society/reef, Apache-2.0) is infrastructure for continually self-improving agents, with roughly 7,500 GitHub stars. Its built-in Reefine recipe turns a plain-language request into a versioned change to your coding harness — a skill, a rule, an agent command — that you review and install like a release. Today we’ll wire Reef to Ollama, teach our agent a new habit, and inspect the version history.

item.title: Nvidia in early talks to buy Reflection AI, the $25B open-weights lab it already backs — FT
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Financial Times reports that Nvidia is in early talks to acquire or deepen its investment in Reflection AI, the open-weights lab behind Monday's Beam launch. An acqui-hire — hire the team, license the tech — could dodge a lengthy regulatory review; neither company commented.

item.title: Run your own deep-research agent: hands-on with Local Deep Research
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Local Deep Research (LearningCircuit/local-deep-research, MIT) is a self-hosted, open-source deep-research agent: roughly 9,200 GitHub stars, running on your own machine with Ollama and SearXNG, every answer returned with citations. Today we'll install it, run a cited research report, and build a private searchable knowledge base.
